column1: # ci/areas.tsv - which test files each CI area runs. Read by tools/ci_select.py (make test-changed|test-area|test-list, make ci).
# One line per area:   <area><TAB><lane><TAB><test globs, space separated, or - for none>
#   lane: light (shares 2 slots, may run next to a heavy run) or heavy (takes the one heavy slot, tools/cilock.py).
#   globs: fnmatch on git-tracked paths, `*` also matches `/`. A glob that matches no tracked file FAILs the
#          selector test (stale glob); so does a tracked test_*.py that no area reaches (an orphan never runs).
#   always: not selectable by a rule; added to every selection that runs any test (repo-wide gates).
#   lint, security, docs: action areas. lint/security run through make lint / make security (no test files).
